examples.title: Verify payloads of a streamed archive

description: Walk LOCAL headers in stream order with bounded memory (zipnative's central-directory-less reader). The only tool that works on a truncated archive or a stream cut mid-way (it cannot skip an SFX prefix: the stream must start at a local header) — and the only one whose result is NOT authoritative: forward iteration trusts local headers ALONE, so a hostile archive can present different content here than inspect_zip / list_zip_entries report (the upload-scanner differential). Prefer those tools whenever the whole archive is available; use this one for forensics (`tolerateTruncation:true` returns the partial inventory + `error`). data 'none' skips payloads, 'verify' decompresses to check CRCs, 'include' returns them (inline caps). `stoppedAt` tells you whether a central directory was reached. Names are NOT sanitized — `sanitizedPath` shows what the extraction gate would use.

data.description: 'none' (default): skip payloads (a data-descriptor entry still costs a full decompress-and-discard); 'verify': decompress every kept entry so CRC and sizes are checked; 'include': also return the content as base64 (inline caps apply).

fields.description: Dot-paths to keep, after verbosity (e.g. ['entryCount', 'entries.name']); unmatched ones are listed in _meta.unmatchedFields.

filter.description: Select entries: `names` (exact), `prefix`, `glob` (`*` in a segment, `**` across, `?`, `[a-z]`; no `/` = any depth, trailing `/` = subtree), ANDed; `includeDirectories` (default false).

glob.description: Patterns (≤ 1024 characters); ANY match keeps the entry (e.g. ['**/*.json', 'docs/']).

includeDirectories.description: Keep explicit directory entries (names ending in `/`).

names.description: Exact entry names to keep (case-sensitive; every duplicate of a name is kept).

prefix.description: Keep entries whose name starts with this prefix (e.g. 'src/').

limits.description: Per-call override of zipnative's security bounds (CWE-400/409); absent keys keep the engine defaults (describe_engine.defaultLimits). A value above its operator ceiling is LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED. Raise only for trusted input.

maxEntryCompressedSize.description: Bytes, one compressed payload fetched by the byte-range reader (access range).

maxEntries.description: Stop after this many local headers (bounded work on an unbounded stream). Default 10000, clamped to the operator ceiling ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_ENTRIES; an explicit value above the ceiling is refused (LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED).

strict.description: Turn the first engine diagnostic into a ZIP_STRICT_DIAGNOSTIC error.

tolerateTruncation.description: true: a truncated / corrupt stream ends the scan with `stoppedAt:"error"` and the partial inventory (forensics) instead of failing the call.

verbosity.description: 'summary': scalar verdict fields only (the token-frugal form).

zipBase64.description: Archive bytes, base64 (≤ 128 MiB decoded). Exclusive with zipPath.

zipPath.description: Archive path relative to the ZIPNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (container extensions: .zip .jar .docx .epub …). Exclusive with zipBase64; saves re-sending bytes between calls.

name: scan_zip_forward

outputSchema.description: Forward-scan inventory (local headers only). Every property is optional because the result can be projected: verbosity:'summary' returns only the scalar summary fields, fields:[...] keeps a dot-path subset. Defaults return the full shape.

bytesDelivered.description: Bytes handed to the forward reader.

diagnosticCount.description: summary only: number of distinct diagnostics.

diagnostics.description: Non-fatal engine concerns (de-duplicated by code + entry, ≤ 200; codes in describe_engine.diagnosticCodes). Empty for a clean archive.

diagnosticsTruncated.description: true when rows beyond 200 were dropped.

crc32.description: CRC-32 of the uncompressed data, 8 lowercase hex digits.

extendedTimestamps.description: With includeExtendedTimestamps: modification / access / creation instants (ISO-8601, UTC) from the UT (0x5455) extra, else the NTFS (0x000a) extra, else the DOS fields (source names which); a missing one is null.

index.description: Position in the central directory (or in the forward scan).

isSymlink.description: Unix mode S_IFLNK; null from a forward scan.

kept.description: false when the filter dropped it (row kept for the inventory, payload skipped).

lastModified.description: ISO-8601 (DOS time has 2-second granularity; UT extra refines it).

sanitizedPath.description: The relative path a secure extraction would use; null when the name cannot be made safe (traversal, absolute, drive/UNC, NUL, ADS, device name).

unixIds.description: With includeUnixIds: the Unix owner uid / gid from the Info-ZIP ux (0x7875) extra; null when the archive carries none.

unixMode.description: Octal permission bits when Unix-authored ('0644'), else null.

maxEntries.description: The header budget in force (after clamping to the operator ceiling).

names.description: summary only: the kept entry names.

stoppedAt.description: 'central-directory' is the normal end of a complete archive; 'eof' means the stream ended before any central directory (truncated or CD-less); 'max-entries' means more local headers remained.

truncated.description: true when the stream ended without reaching a central directory.

trust.description: Constant reminder: nothing here was cross-checked against a central directory.

title: Scan forward (truncated / unseekable streams — NOT authoritative)
